title: Scalar tensor representatives with specified derived endpoints
statement: Let phi:A -> B be a homomorphism of commutative rings and T a scheme. Let q be the localization tensor representative [lem-pur-upper-star-single-tensor-representative], preceded by the equality isomorphism scalarTensorFunctor_eq of [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. This gives a concrete map q_phi(P):Q(P) tensor_A^L B_T[0] -> Q(P tensor_A B_T), with exactly the scalar tensor functor endpoint, for every cochain complex P. The defining normalization of scalarTensorIso [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] is e(QP);q_phi(P);Q(balancing_P)=U(rep_phi(P));restrictionFactors, with the comparison maps of [def-pur-scalar-pullback-representative-data]. If P is K-flat then q_phi(P) is invertible. The endpoint transport is an equality isomorphism for two expressions of the same concrete tensor functor.

proof.text: Construct q_phi(P) as the component of the equality iso scalarTensorFunctor_eq followed by the canonical localization tensorator and total-tensor/single-complex iso. This fixes its source to the scalar tensor functor exactly.

Apply the defining scalarTensorModelNormalization of scalarTensorIso. The complex composition comparison associated with a reflexive functor iso has identity in each degree. Its localization is identity. Cancel it and reassociate the endpoint equality iso with q. This gives the displayed scalar representative formula.

For K-flat P the localization tensorator is invertible in the first variable. The total-tensor/single-complex comparison and endpoint equality iso are invertible. Their composite q_phi(P) is invertible.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarTensorIso_representative
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B) (T : Scheme.{u})
    (P : CochainComplex (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) ℤ) :
    (scalarTensorIso φ T).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
        scalarTensorRepresentative φ T P ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map
          ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (scalarSheafTensorTransformation φ T)
            (.up ℤ)).app P) =
      (Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars T.smallEtaleTopology φ).map
          (scalarExtensionRepresentative φ T P) ≫
        (Sheaf.restrictScalars T.smallEtaleTopology φ).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
          (((ProEtale.etaleSheafExtendScalars φ T).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
